quest.save_princess.desc: Garland has taken the princess to the Temple of Chaos, northwest of Cornelia.
quest.to_pravoka.desc: The king has rebuilt the bridge north of Cornelia. Cross it and head east, toward the port town of Pravoka.
king.intro.1: So, the crystals you carry... You must be the Warriors of Light that the sage Lukahn spoke of.
king.intro.2: I am ashamed to ask this of strangers, but I have no one else to turn to. My daughter, Princess Sarah, has been taken.
king.intro.3: The one who took her is Garland, once the finest knight of this realm. He has holed up in the Temple of Chaos to the northwest.
king.intro.4: I beg you, Warriors of Light: bring my daughter home. Should you succeed, I will rebuild the bridge to the east for you.
king.waiting: Garland waits in the Temple of Chaos, northwest of here. Please, bring Sarah home safely.
king.thanks.1: Sarah! You are safe... Warriors of Light, you have my deepest gratitude.
king.thanks.2: Garland was the pride of Cornelia. What darkness could have turned his heart?
king.thanks.3: As I promised, the bridge to the east shall be rebuilt at once. May the light of the crystals guide you.
king.after: The bridge north of the town now stands again. The road east leads to the port of Pravoka.
princess.lute.1: Thank you for saving me. Garland... he spoke of a power that would return him to the past, again and again.
princess.lute.2: Please take this. The royal family has kept it for generations. It is said that one day it will open the way for the Warriors of Light.
princess.lute.3: I pray that it serves you well on your journey.
princess.after: The lute has been passed down in my family for a very long time. Please take good care of it.
garland.1: No one shall touch the princess!
garland.2: You would challenge Garland? Then I shall strike you all down myself!
garland.defeated: Impossible... But this is not the end. You will see me again...
garland.rescue: Garland vanished in a flash of darkness. The party escorted Princess Sarah back to Castle Cornelia.
bridge.built: The king's builders went to work, and before long a new bridge spanned the river north of the town.
throne_guard: You stand before the King of Cornelia. Mind your manners.
throne_guard.after: The princess is home! The whole castle owes you a debt.
gate_guard: This is Castle Cornelia. The king's chamber is on the upper floor.
gate_guard.after: Warriors of Light! You brought the princess back. Go on in.
hall_guard: The stairs at the end of the carpet lead up to the throne room.
chancellor.1: Garland was the bravest knight Cornelia ever had. Everyone looked up to him.
chancellor.2: And yet he took the princess and fled to the old temple. I still cannot believe it.
chancellor.after: You have done what our entire army could not. The king is in your debt.
maid: The princess's room has stood empty for days. I can hardly bear to look at it.
maid.after: The princess is back! I will have her room ready by tonight.
sage.1: Four hundred years ago the sage Lukahn left a prophecy.
sage.2: He foretold that in an age of darkness, four warriors bearing crystals would appear to save the world.
dancer: Welcome to Cornelia! Isn't it a lovely town?
townsman: Garland kidnapped the princess? He was the king's most trusted knight. I don't understand it.
townsman.after: They say the princess is back in the castle. Thank goodness!
woman: The Temple of Chaos lies northwest of town. Nobody goes near it anymore.
woman.after: Garland is gone, and the temple is quiet again. You have our thanks.
oldman.1: The winds have died down and the seas are rough. The earth itself is rotting.
oldman.2: Everyone is waiting for the Warriors of Light from the old prophecy.
girl: The bridge to the east has been broken for a long time. Nobody can get to Pravoka.
girl.after: The king rebuilt the bridge! Now people can travel east again.
scholar: The four crystals have lost their light. Earth, Fire, Water and Wind... they are all fading.
prologue.1: Darkness has fallen over the world. The wind is silent, the seas churn, and the land is withering.
prologue.2: In these troubled times, people cling to an old prophecy.
prologue.3: It tells of four Warriors of Light who will appear when darkness covers the land.
prologue.4: Now, at the end of a long road, four young travelers have come. Each of them carries a crystal.
intro.1: Long ago, four crystals kept the world in balance: Earth, Fire, Water and Wind.
intro.2: But their light has begun to fade, and a creeping darkness spreads across the land.
intro.3: The sage Lukahn foretold that in this age of darkness, four warriors bearing crystals would appear.
intro.4: And now four young travelers stand before the kingdom of Cornelia, each holding a dim crystal...
quest.to_elfheim.desc: With a ship of your own, sail south across the sea to Elfheim, the land of the elves.
bikke.1: Well, well. Look what washed into my harbor. This town belongs to Captain Bikke now!
bikke.2: Lads! Teach these fools what happens to anyone who crosses a pirate!
bikke.beg.1: Stop, stop! I give up! We'll leave the town alone, I swear it on my beard!
bikke.beg.2: Here, take my ship as well, just let me go! She's moored at the harbor.
bikke.after: I've given up the sea for good. Treat my old ship kindly, will you?
ship.received: The party received the ship! It waits at the Pravoka harbor.
pirate: Arr, Captain Bikke runs this port. Get lost!
pravoka.woman: Pirates came ashore and took over the harbor. Nobody dares go out at night.
pravoka.woman.after: The pirates are gone! The town can finally breathe again.
pravoka.oldman.1: Far to the south across the sea lies Elfheim, the kingdom of the elves.
pravoka.oldman.2: They say the elf prince has fallen into an endless sleep.
pravoka.merchant: With pirates in the harbor, no ship has left port for weeks. Business is terrible.
pravoka.merchant.after: The harbor is open again! You can sail anywhere now, if you have a ship.
pravoka.dancer: Welcome to Pravoka, the port town! Sailors from all over used to come here.
quest.wake_prince.desc: The prince of Elfheim lies under a sleeping curse. Only a rare medicine can wake him.
quest.find_crown.desc: The king of the Western Keep asks for his crown, stolen and hidden deep in the Marsh Cave to the south.
quest.return_eye.desc: Astos stole the Crystal Eye from the blind witch Matoya. Return it to her cave, north of Pravoka.
doctor.1: The prince has been asleep for years. The dark elf Astos laid a curse on him.
doctor.2: No cure of ours can wake him. They say the witch Matoya once brewed a tonic strong enough. Her cave lies far to the north.
doctor.after: His Highness is awake! I never thought I would see this day.
prince.asleep: The prince sleeps deeply and does not stir.
prince.wake: The party gave the Jolt Tonic to the prince. His eyes slowly opened.
prince.thanks.1: Where... how long have I slept? You broke the curse of Astos?
prince.thanks.2: I can never repay you. Please take this: the Mystic Key, treasure of our people.
prince.thanks.3: It opens every sealed door in the world, in Cornelia and beyond.
prince.after: Astos is gone, and Elfheim is free. May your road be safe, Warriors of Light.
elf_guard: Our prince sleeps in the great hall. Please be quiet.
elf_guard.after: The prince is awake! All of Elfheim rejoices.
elf.a: Welcome to Elfheim. Few travelers cross the sea to reach us.
elf.b: A strange king has settled in the ruined Western Keep. I would not trust him.
elf.c: These graves belong to those who fell in the wars against the dark elves.
elf.d: The Marsh Cave lies south of here. The poison there has killed many. Take antidotes.
elf.e: Our prince has slept for so long. The castle north of town is very quiet now.
elf.e.after: They say the prince has woken. Tonight we sing!
keep.intro.1: Ah, travelers. I am the king of this keep, though you see how little remains of it.
keep.intro.2: My crown was stolen and hidden in the Marsh Cave to the south. Bring it back, and you shall have my thanks.
keep.waiting: The crown lies at the bottom of the Marsh Cave. Hurry.
keep.crown.1: My crown! At last. Give it here.
keep.crown.2: Fools! You have played right into my hands.
keep.crown.3: I am Astos, lord of the dark elves! With this crown I shall rule. Die!
astos.defeated: Astos fell. Among his belongings lay a gleaming crystal.
matoya.blind.1: Who's there? I can't see a thing! Some thief has taken my Crystal Eye.
matoya.blind.2: Without it I am as blind as a mole. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
matoya.eye.1: That glow... my Crystal Eye! I can see again, every wrinkle of it.
matoya.eye.2: You kept your word, so here is mine. This tonic could wake the dead, or at least the sleeping.
matoya.after: Off with you, I have potions to brew. Mind the brooms on your way out.
